title: All Paths From Source Lead To Destination
description: Determine if all paths from source node start at source and end at destination, where destination has no outgoing edges.
pseudocode:
1. function dfs(curr, target, graph, visited):
2.   if graph[curr].length == 0:
3.     return curr == target
4.   for neighbor in graph[curr]:
5.     if !dfs(neighbor, target, graph, visited):
6.       return false
7.   return true

steps.note: Starting DFS from node 0 to find paths to node 3.
Node 2 has an edge to 3, checking branch.
Node 3 has no outgoing edges. Checking if curr == target.
All paths confirmed leading to destination.
